text: Aqua 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的玻璃质感主题插件，通过主题覆盖层和侧栏控制页调整应用外观。它提供可调磨砂模糊、流体或自选图片与视频背景、字体字号和颜色配置，并支持环境装饰与弹出菜单行为设置。适合希望个性化 DSH 阅读和对话界面的用户；壁纸与设置保存在本机浏览器，无需额外配置。控制页也能切换主题开关，随时恢复主界面原有外观。

Aqua adds a glass theme and sidebar controls to the DSH web client. Users can tune blur, frost, fonts and colors, or choose fluid, image and video backgrounds. Local browser storage keeps its settings and media.
想把 DSH 的界面改成可调节的磨砂玻璃风格。
能不能给 DSH 对话页换个流体渐变或自选壁纸背景？
我想细调聊天界面的模糊程度、透明度和颜色。
怎么分别设置正文、代码和终端的字体与字号？
希望给 DSH 换成自己喜欢的字体，并保存下来。
让 DSH 的主题跟随浅色和深色模式切换。
I want a frosted glass look with adjustable blur in my DSH interface.
Can I use a custom image or video as the conversation background?
Aqua 的「磨砂玻璃外观」：在侧栏主题面板调节模糊、磨砂和聊天区域透明度，修改即时应用到界面。
Aqua 的「流体与壁纸背景」：从面板选择流体背景，或导入图片、视频作为壁纸，并单独调整模糊、磨砂或亮度。
Aqua 的「字体与排版」：分别配置正文、代码和终端的字体字号，也可调整字重、行高和配色方案。
Aqua 的「界面装饰」：在控制面板启用或关闭浮游生物、鲸鱼、互动网格和光标聚光效果。
Aqua 的主题挂钩面向 DSH 0.2.x 客户端版本；升级到其他版本时，界面挂钩或面板挂载可能不兼容。

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Credits：Aqua is a highly customizable glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI and desktop app. The floating header, composer and stats line, and the trajectory view become panes of frosted glass, while the main column can sit on the living fluid board or on your own wallpaper (image or video); the sidebar keeps its stock look. Switch it off and the stock UI comes back exactly, with no source changes to DSH itself.

section: Option 1: desktop app — install from the in-app plugins page (recommended)

text:
@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Option 2: one-shot script (Windows)：The script **installs from npm by default**, so it is Option 3 with the typing done for you — plus it clears any stale junction left behind by an earlier link install.

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Invoke-WebRequest 'https://github.com/ZHUBAI0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix/raw/main/install.ps1' -OutFile install.ps1; .\install.ps1"
```

Options:

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Option 2: one-shot script (Windows)：| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-Profile desktop` | target profile (default `web`) |
| `-Version v2.0.5` | pin a version (default: npm's `latest`; the script reads the dist-tag and pins it, because pnpm's `minimumReleaseAge` otherwise resolves to an older release) |
| `-DshHome <path>` | DSH home (default `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`) |
| `-Link` | **development only**, see below |

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Option 2: one-shot script (Windows)：Flow: locate the `dsh` CLI, remove stale junctions in both known locations, then `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <pkg[@version]>`.

**`-Link` is for development only**: it downloads the source, verifies `lib/client.js` against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, creates a junction in that profile's `node_modules` pointing at the clone, and registers `cordis.patch.yml`.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Option 2: one-shot script (Windows)：> ⚠️ **Do not use `-Link` for a normal install.** A junction puts the app's file operations inside the source tree — uninstalling or rolling back the "installed package" deletes files in the real clone, which is how this repo lost `.git/HEAD`, `.git/config` and `.git/index`. It also blocks any later npm install:
>
> ```
> [ERR_PNPM_EPERM] [importPackage ...] rename ... EPERM: operation not permitted
> ```
>
> pnpm renames the freshly unpacked directory over the target, and NTFS refuses to replace a reparse point whose data lives on another volume. To go back to npm, just **run the script again without `-Link`** — it deletes the link itself and never the source.
>
> Removing it by hand is fine too, but never with a recursive delete (older tooling follows into the target and would destroy the clone):
>
> ```powershell
> cmd /c rmdir "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@zhubai0528\dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix"
> ```

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Option 3: npm：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix
```

Installs the latest version from npm and registers it as a profile plugin layer (`dsh.bundle` patch) on every platform. Reload the UI and it is on.

npm page: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix>

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Option 3: npm：> Requires Node.js and npm locally. If the official registry is slow from your network, a mirror can be used; note that mirror sync lags behind, so a just-published version may not be there yet.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Option 4: manual (macOS / Linux)：```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ZHUBAI0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix.git
ln -s "$PWD/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix" "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix"
```

then append to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-aqua
      name: '@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix'
```

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Usage：Reload the UI. Aqua is **on by default**; the master switch sits at the top of the **Glass theme** page in the left sidebar (it is its own page, not a tab inside Plugins/Settings).

The panel is a tab strip, one page per tab:

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Usage：| Tab | Contents |
|---|---|
| `Glass material` | glass blur, frost |
| `Backdrop` | fluid / wallpaper, hue, colour depth, background brightness, conversation blur, menu page blur, submenu opacity |
| `Font & size` | face sources, the three sizes, body / heading weights, explanatory weight and strength |
| `Font colours` | font colour schemes (two colours each, reversed with the appearance), a solid conversation ink, global explanatory colour |
| `Regions` | per-region weights and explanatory overrides for sidebar / header / conversation / composer, line height, per-region reset |
| `Decorations` | particle whale, fish, interactive mesh, cursor glow, click keeps submenus open |

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Usage：Every glass surface shares one **edge recipe**: a 1px rim light along the outline, a lit corner plus the opposite corner's shade (together they read as glass thickness), and a soft refraction fringe along the top and bottom edges — cool white in light mode, a dimmer rim with a cool blue fringe in dark mode, so the edge never looks like a painted white border.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Usage：The choice is remembered: leaving the page and coming back — or restarting DSH — lands on the tab you were last on (stored under `dsh.ui-aqua.panelTab`); pick `Backdrop` to go back to the default.

> The upstream **Mode** group (Mica / Compatibility) was removed entirely in 2.0.0.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Backdrop and visual controls：The backdrop comes from one of two sources, switched with a segmented control at the top of the settings panel. The default is **fluid**. Every numeric control pairs a slider with a number box: dragging applies live, typing sets an exact value, and out-of-range input clamps to the nearest bound. Settings persist locally across reloads.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Backdrop and visual controls：**Fluid (default)** is a live gradient board driven by two knobs — **Hue** over 0–360° (default 320°, a magenta-leaning tone) and **Colour depth** over 0–100% (default 25%).

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Backdrop and visual controls：**Image and video wallpapers** are added with **Choose image** and **Choose video**. Picking either file switches the backdrop source to wallpaper automatically, so the segmented control does not need touching. Images accept any format the browser can decode (PNG, JPG, WebP and so on); video accepts MP4, WebM, Ogg and QuickTime. Once a wallpaper is loaded, a **Delete wallpaper** button appears and clears it back to pure fluid.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Backdrop and visual controls：The two wallpaper types expose different knobs: images get **Wallpaper blur** and **Wallpaper frost**, while video gets **Video blur** and **Video brightness** — a video has no separate frost layer, so brightness works with the automatic dimming to keep text readable.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Controls at a glance：| Control | Applies to | Range | Step | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Backdrop source | all | Fluid / Wallpaper | — | Fluid |
| Hue | fluid | 0–360° | 1° | 320° |
| Colour depth | fluid | 0–100% | 1% | 25% |
| Wallpaper blur | image | 0–40 px | 0.5 px | 0 |
| Wallpaper frost | image | 0–100% | 1% | 0 |
| Video blur | video | 0–40 px | 0.5 px | 6 px |
| Video brightness | video | 0–100% | 1% | 45% |
| Glass blur | all | 0–40 px | 0.5 px | 20 px |
| Conversation blur | all | 0–40 px | 0.5 px | 14 px |
| Menu page blur | all | 0–40 px | 0.5 px | 14 px |
| Frost | all | 0–100% | 1% | 7% |
| Background brightness | all | dark 0–50 / light 50–100 | 1% | 50 |
| Submenu opacity | all | 0–100% | 1% | 96% |

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Controls at a glance：**Background brightness** narrows its range with the active scheme: dark mode offers 0–50 (0 fades to pure black, 50 unchanged) and light mode offers 50–100 (50 unchanged, 100 brightens to pure white). The other half is unreachable, so a value picked in one scheme stays inert in the other.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Controls at a glance：**Submenu opacity** is a separate knob because popovers float above body and composer text and need a denser fill than the cards. The chat slab still carries a thin veil (25%, no longer exposed as a knob) — the two blur knobs already decide how much of the backdrop shows through.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Controls at a glance：The conversation area carries two blur knobs and picks one by the **left sidebar's state**, so only one is ever in force: **Conversation blur** while a session record is open, **Menu page blur** while a page opened from the left menu (settings, plugins, schedules) is on screen. The settings page's own frost follows the latter too, so dragging it there shows the change immediately.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Controls at a glance：**Glass blur** also scales that same readable sheet (20 px is the 1.0 baseline, 0 clears it entirely, 40 doubles it). That is not a shortcut: the column carries the only backdrop blur in the chat, and nothing inside it — the header card, the composer, the bubbles — can add a blur of its own, so the material knob has to act on that layer for it to reach them.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Fonts and typography：The **Font & size** tab covers three things: where the faces come from, how big they are, and how heavy they are, with the note under each control saying what it reaches. **Font colours** and **Regions** are separate tabs — the first sets body colour and the explanatory-text colour source, the second fine-tunes each region.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Fonts and typography：**Font colour schemes** sit in four columns and carry two colours each (body ink + accent) — the name spells out exactly those two, so it flips with the appearance ("Ink · Vermilion" in light, "Cloud · Amber" in dark) and never advertises a colour the card is not showing. The selected card is outlined with the scheme's own accent instead of the desktop preset's blue. Hovering a scheme opens a tooltip that closes on leave. **Conversation ink** is a single solid colour for the transcript, and **explanatory colour** now offers thirteen stops; following the scheme picks up that scheme's derived explanatory tone.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Fonts and typography：**Where faces come from** — body, code and explanatory copy each have their own picker, defaulting to `Theme default`. The built-ins fall into three groups: system faces (Microsoft YaHei, DengXian, SimHei, SimSun, KaiTi, Consolas, Cascadia Code), open source (Source Han Sans / Serif, LXGW WenKai, Sarasa Mono, JetBrains Mono) and free for commercial use (MiSans, HarmonyOS Sans). A preset is only a `font-family` candidate list — **it takes effect only if the face is installed**, otherwise the next fallback applies.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Fonts and typography：**Importing your own** — pick a local `.ttf`, `.otf`, `.woff` or `.woff2` up to **24 MB** (anything larger is rejected with a message instead of failing silently). `.ttc` collections are refused because `@font-face` cannot address a single weight inside one. Files live in the browser's IndexedDB, so they survive restarts, and each import is actually loaded once to verify it — a broken file says so rather than claiming success. A working import shows up in all three pickers and is selected for body text.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Fonts and typography：The × on each row removes a face after a confirmation; if it was in use, the related settings fall back to `Theme default` instead of pointing at a face that no longer exists. Re-importing the same family reuses the existing record, so the list never grows duplicate rows that cannot be selected.

**The weight sliders are stepped** — between 300 and 800 there are only six stops (step 100), and every stop is labelled under the track.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Fonts and typography：| Setting | Range | Step | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| Body size | 10–22 px | 1 px | 14 px |
| Code size | 10–16 px | 1 px | 11 px |
| Terminal size | 10–20 px | 1 px | 13 px |
| Body weight | 300–800 | 100 (6 stops, labelled) | 400 |
| Heading weight | 400–800 | 100 (5 stops, labelled) | 600 |
| Explanatory weight | 300–800 | 100 (6 stops, labelled) | 400 |
| Explanatory strength | 40–100% | 5% | 80% global / 92% per region |
| Line height | 1–2.5 | 0.05 | 1.5 |

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Fonts and typography：Explanatory strength steps in 5% but reads as one continuous fade, so it carries no scale; only weight, where a single step is visibly different, does.

Two layers of state: sizes belong to the host theme service (the same value as Settings → Appearance, kept in sync both ways), while faces and weights are stored by this plugin.

@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix README · Local development：```sh
npm install
npm run bundle      # build lib/ (tsdown → inlined CSS → ESM→CJS shim)
npm run watch       # watch build
```

Before publishing, inspect the tarball with `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\publish.ps1 -DryRun`; drop `-DryRun` to publish for real.
